title: Homotopy uniqueness of Cartan--Eilenberg comparison lifts
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal B$ be abelian categories with enough injectives, let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be an exact additive functor, and let $K^\bullet$ and $L^\bullet$ be cochain complexes in $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal B$ with $K^p=L^p=0$ for $p<0$. Let $I_K$ be a Cartan--Eilenberg injective resolution of $K^\bullet$ and $J_L$ one of $L^\bullet$ [lem-sp-cartan-eilenberg-exists], with augmentations $\epsilon_K:K^\bullet\to I_K^{\bullet,0}$ and $\epsilon_L:L^\bullet\to J_L^{\bullet,0}$. Let $u,u':F(K^\bullet)\to L^\bullet$ be homotopic complex maps, with homotopy $s:F(K^p)\to L^{p-1}$, and let $\phi,\psi:F(I_K)\to J_L$ be morphisms of double complexes whose augmentations satisfy $\phi\,F(\epsilon_K)=\epsilon_L\,u$ and $\psi\,F(\epsilon_K)=\epsilon_L\,u'$. Then there is a homotopy $H$ between the induced total-complex maps, so $\operatorname{Tot}(\phi)-\operatorname{Tot}(\psi)=dH+Hd$, and $H(F^q\operatorname{Tot}^n)\subseteq F^{q-1}\operatorname{Tot}^{n-1}$ for the decreasing filtration $F$ by resolution degree [def-sp-filtration]. In particular, when $u=u'$ one may take $s=0$ and the two comparison maps are homotopic by a homotopy lowering resolution degree by one.

source.place: Lemma 015I (lemma-cartan-eilenberg), comparison morphism construction, and Remark 015K (remark-functorial-ss)

proof.text: Let G be F applied to natural-indexed cochain complexes, and let GG apply G in the horizontal direction. The canonical singleMapHomologicalComplex isomorphism a identifies GG(single K) with single(F K). Define the augmentation eFI = a.inv followed by GG(eI). The exactness of F makes G exact and preserves quasi-isomorphisms. Naturality of ShortComplex.mapCyclesIso and mapHomologyIso identifies the cycle and homology augmentations of GG(eI) with G applied to the original augmentations, up to isomorphisms. For boundaries, use PreservesImage.iso; its naturality square follows after composing with the monomorphic image inclusion. Precomposition by a.inv preserves all three quasi-isomorphisms. G also preserves the zero columns below degree zero.

source.place: Lemma 015I and Remark 015K, comparison of Cartan--Eilenberg resolutions

proof.text: Set delta = phi - psi and w = u - u'. Homotopy.equivSubZero turns the given s into a null-homotopy of w. In degree p, use its components s.hom p (p - 1) and the homotopy identity with the up-integer predecessor and successor. The two supplied augmentation squares subtract to give eFI followed by delta = w followed by eJ, using the degree-zero component of the canonical single-complex isomorphism. Apply lem-sp-cartan-eilenberg-double-complex-homotopy to F(I), J, these augmentations, delta, w and s. Its hypotheses on J are precisely the supplied resolution and row-injectivity assumptions.

source.place: Lemma 015I and Remark 015K, comparison of Cartan--Eilenberg resolutions

proof.text: Retain the total-existence witnesses, null-homotopy H and filtration factorization returned by the double-complex lemma. Prove Tot(E(phi - psi)) = Tot(E(phi)) - Tot(E(psi)) by additivity of E and extensionality on every total diagonal coprojection, using the total-map coprojection formula [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Regard H as a null-homotopy of that difference by changing only its commutativity proof. Apply Homotopy.equivSubZero.symm; its components remain definitionally H.hom, so the returned factorization from filtration step q to step q - 1 is unchanged.
